text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّۢ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا

words.gloss_range: opening connector with both continuation and fresh-resumption force
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as both continuation and fresh launch. It keeps the prior warning in view while shifting into the settled decree frame that will organize worship, parents, aging, and speech.

topics.headline: connector launches a fresh decree while continuing the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not detached from the prior warning; it opens a new decree register while carrying the command chain forward.
topics.reason: The initial connector can coordinate with the prior prohibition or resume a fresh section, and the boundary rows show a shift from consequence warning into relational legislation.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form I decree verb governing the worship and parental-duty content
words.root_gloss_range: completion, judgment, decree, and final settlement; local syntax selects divine decree with variants exposing a counsel contrast

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nominative possessed subject naming the source of the decree

words.prose: {{ar:قَضَىٰ}} ({{tr:qaḍā}}) places the completed divine act before the named subject, so the reader meets the finalizing decree before hearing {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}). Its completion/judgment range makes the following worship restriction and parental excellence settled obligations; accepted counsel or nominal variants sharpen that force by contrast, while the local form remains verbal decree. The emphatic ḍād gives the word a heavy consonantal center that suits this settled legal register. The same root links divine determination in (17:4) to legislation here, and the decree is answered inside the ayah by disciplined human speech.

topics.headline: perfect decree frames the duties as already settled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worship-exclusivity and parental care enter as finalized divine decree, not as counsel or social advice.
topics.reason: {{ar:قَضَىٰ}} ({{tr:qaḍā}}) is a perfect Form I verb before its named subject, and the following content clause is governed by that completed act of decree.

topics.headline: variant readings expose the force of the standard decree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variant pressure makes the standard wording feel more final, while the canonical local surface remains verbal decree.
topics.reason: The counsel and nominal-decree variants are useful contrastive evidence, but the local Hafs surface remains the perfect verb of divine action.

topics.headline: decree becomes human speech discipline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local and surah-level movement from what God settles to what the human must and must not say.
topics.reason: Rows connect the decree root with earlier same-surah judgment in (17:4) and with the q-w-l speech axis inside this ayah.

topics.headline: heavy consonant and boundary support settled register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the decree word carry a weight that suits the shift into settled legislation.
topics.reason: The sound row treats the emphatic center of {{ar:قَضَىٰ}} ({{tr:qaḍā}}) as a small phonetic support for the legal register.

words.gloss_range: nominative possessed divine title as the explicit subject of the decree
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, ownership, nurturing, and cultivation; locally the sustaining Lord is tied to the addressee by the suffix
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) names the source of the decree as the addressee's own sustaining Lord. The suffix makes the command relational, and the r-b-b nurture field matters because the same decree immediately turns to parents; in (17:24), the root returns in the parents' raising, so divine nurturing and remembered parental nurturing are placed in one arc.

topics.headline: possessed Lord personalizes the decree source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decree comes from the addressee's own sustaining Lord, not from an abstract legal voice.
topics.reason: {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) is nominative subject of the decree and carries the 2ms suffix, binding the source of command to the addressee.

topics.headline: divine nurturing frames parental nurturing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title of the One decreeing parental care already carries nurturing and raising pressure, answered by the parents' raising in (17:24).
topics.reason: The r-b-b evidence supports care and cultivation, and the next ayah repeats the root in the remembered parental raising (17:24).

words.gloss_range: fused complementizer-negation introducing the first decree content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: detached accusative pronoun as exclusive worship object

words.prose: {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:allā}}) compresses subordination and negation into the start of the decree content. The form makes non-worship of any rival the first governed unit, then joins with {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) and {{ar:إِيَّاهُ}} ({{tr:iyyāhu}}) to build the full exclusivity chain.

topics.headline: subordination and negation fuse into decree content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first decreed content is built as a negated worship clause from its opening particle.
topics.reason: {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:allā}}) fuses complementizer and negation, and the following subjunctive worship verb is governed as content of {{ar:قَضَىٰ}} ({{tr:qaḍā}}).

topics.headline: negation joins exception and pronoun into exclusivity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exclusivity produced by a chain, not by a single isolated word.
topics.reason: The row links {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:allā}}), {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}), and {{ar:إِيَّاهُ}} ({{tr:iyyāhu}}) as the complete restriction mechanism.

words.gloss_range: 2mp imperfect subjunctive worship verb inside the negated decree clause
words.root_gloss_range: service, worship, obedience, and repeated devoted treading; locally rival devotional direction is excluded
words.prose: {{ar:تَعْبُدُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:taʿbudū}}) is subjunctive under the fused particle, so worship is commanded as dependent decree content rather than described. Its plural imperfect form gives the duty an ongoing communal reach, and the root's service and path-wearing pressure makes worship repeated devoted direction; the boundary from the rival deity ban in (17:22) becomes enacted exclusive devotion here, echoing covenantal worship-plus-parents wording such as (2:83).

topics.headline: subjunctive plural worship is decree content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that worship is commanded as ongoing communal devotion inside the decree, not reported as a fact.
topics.reason: {{ar:تَعْبُدُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:taʿbudū}}) is 2mp imperfect subjunctive under {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:allā}}), so mood and number shape it as dependent command content.

topics.headline: worship is sustained devoted service
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ban excludes every rival route of repeated service, not only a ritual gesture.
topics.reason: The root evidence gives service, obedience, worship, and path-wearing imagery; local negation-exception directs that whole devotion field to one object.

topics.headline: exclusive worship joins covenant formula and prior deity ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that (17:23) turns the prior ban on rival deity-placement into enacted exclusive worship, while echoing covenantal worship-plus-parents formulas such as (2:83).
topics.reason: The rows cite the formula in (2:83) and track the boundary from the rival deity object in (17:22) into the worship action in (17:23).

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the negation-exception restriction
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge of restriction. After negated worship, it clears every possible worship object and turns the clause toward the one affirmed object without needing a new sentence.

topics.headline: exception particle turns negation into exclusive affirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that monotheistic affirmation is achieved by first clearing away every other worship object.
topics.reason: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) follows a negated worship verb and pivots the clause from universal exclusion to the single affirmed object.

words.gloss_range: detached accusative pronoun as the exclusive worship object
words.prose: {{ar:إِيَّاهُ}} ({{tr:iyyāhu}}) completes the restriction as an independent accusative pronoun. The worship object is not hidden in a suffix but foregrounded as the exclusive focus, resolving back to the named divine referent; the iyyā-pronoun structure also recalls the devotion formula in (1:5).

topics.headline: detached pronoun foregrounds the worship object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exclusive object is made visible as an emphatic independent pronoun, not tucked away as a suffix.
topics.reason: {{ar:إِيَّاهُ}} ({{tr:iyyāhu}}) is detached accusative, resolving to the named divine referent while completing the restriction after {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}).

topics.headline: iyyā pronoun recalls exclusive devotion formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun form belongs to a wider exclusivity idiom, explicitly comparable with (1:5).
topics.reason: The source row gives the concrete echo to (1:5), where the same independent-pronoun structure marks devotion exclusivity.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector joining parental duty to worship restriction under one decree

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional parental phrase coordinated into the decree content

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) brings parental excellence into the same decree frame as exclusive worship. By coordinating {{ar:بِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:bi-l-wālidayn}}) with the preceding clause, it prevents the parent-duty from sounding like a secondary add-on.

topics.headline: wāw binds parental excellence to worship restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that parental excellence is not an afterthought; it is coordinated into the same decree frame as exclusive worship.
topics.reason: The connector before {{ar:بِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:bi-l-wālidayn}}) joins the parental clause to the governed content of {{ar:قَضَىٰ}} ({{tr:qaḍā}}).

words.gloss_range: bound preposition directing excellence toward the parents

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accusative maṣdar naming active excellence toward parents

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the duty to its relational target. Here the preposition marks the domain or direction of {{ar:إِحْسَٰنًا}} ({{tr:iḥsānan}}): excellence is to be fastened to the parents, not treated as an abstract virtue floating without recipients.

topics.headline: bound bāʾ makes parents the attached domain of excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that excellence is fastened to a concrete relational target: the parents.
topics.reason: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) governs the parental phrase and marks the directed domain of {{ar:إِحْسَٰنًا}} ({{tr:iḥsānan}}), not an instrument or location.

words.gloss_range: definite dual active-participle noun for the two parents
words.root_gloss_range: begetting, generating, and birth relation; locally parents are named as origin-sources who become care recipients
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-wālidayn}}) is definite, dual, and active-participial, so the command selects the two parents as a bounded pair and names them through their generating relation. They are grammatically recipients of excellence while lexically origin-sources of the addressee. The phrase also belongs to the repeated duty formula of (2:83) and (4:36), and the w-l-d thread later touches children in (17:31) and divine non-begetting in (17:111).

topics.headline: the two parents are named as origin-sources
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target is the bounded pair who generated the addressee, not elders or kin in general.
topics.reason: {{ar:ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-wālidayn}}) is definite dual and active-participial, keeping both specificity and origin-debt in view.

topics.headline: parental phrase participates in fixed duty formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as both locally attached to the excellence command and part of a repeated legal formula in (2:83) and (4:36).
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows the phrase to relate to decree content and to the target of excellence, while inter-ayah rows cite the recurring formula.

topics.headline: surah thread keeps generation and dependency active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the parent word belongs to a larger Surah 17 thread of children, generation, and divine non-begetting in (17:31) and (17:111).
topics.reason: The row supplies concrete same-surah references where the w-l-d root reappears with children and divine non-begetting.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative Form IV maṣdar functioning as a compressed mandate
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, goodness, excellence, and beneficence; locally active excellence toward parents exceeds minimum fairness
words.prose: {{ar:إِحْسَٰنًا}} ({{tr:iḥsānan}}) lands as an accusative maṣdar without an overt command verb, compressing “do excellence” into one heavy noun. Its Form IV and lexical beauty/goodness range make the duty active beneficence that exceeds bare justice, while its indefiniteness leaves every fitting mode of parental excellence open. The h-s-n field later returns to speech ethics in (17:53).

topics.headline: accusative maṣdar compresses a whole command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that parental duty lands as a terse standalone mandate, as if the doing-good verb is already understood.
topics.reason: {{ar:إِحْسَٰنًا}} ({{tr:iḥsānan}}) is accusative without an overt governing verb, compressing an implied command into one verbal noun.

topics.headline: Form IV excellence exceeds minimum fairness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the duty is active beautifying beneficence toward parents, not bare justice or one prescribed act.
topics.reason: The Form IV maṣdar, indefinite form, and lexical evidence for beauty and goodness make the command expansive and active.

topics.headline: excellence opens a speech-ethics thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the parental excellence term anticipates later Surah 17 speech ethics in (17:53).
topics.reason: The row gives the same-surah return of the h-s-n root where speech is explicitly governed by what is better.

words.gloss_range: emphatic conditional particle opening the concrete aging scenario
words.prose: {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:immā}}) pivots from general decree to the concrete aging case. Its emphatic conditional shape holds uncertainty of occurrence together with certainty of required response: if this case arrives, the answer has already been made weighty.

topics.headline: conditional shifts decree into the aging case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from general obligation into the concrete case where parents age in the addressee's presence.
topics.reason: {{ar:إِمَّا}} ({{tr:immā}}) fuses conditional force with emphasis and prepares the intensified reaching verb that follows.

words.gloss_range: imperfect reaching verb with heavy energetic nūn in the condition
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, arriving, and attaining an endpoint; locally old age is a threshold that triggers response
words.prose: {{ar:يَبْلُغَنَّ}} ({{tr:yablughanna}}) treats old age as a threshold reached with emphatic force. The heavy nūn weights the condition, while the standard singular verb states the reaching event before the subject resolves as one parent or both; the dual variant shows another agreement path without displacing the local structure. The old-age formula is mirrored in (3:40), where old age reaches Zachariah.

topics.headline: heavy-nūn reaching makes old age a weighty threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices old age as an emphatically reached threshold after which the response cannot remain casual.
topics.reason: {{ar:يَبْلُغَنَّ}} ({{tr:yablughanna}}) combines reaching-endpoint semantics with heavy energetic nūn, making the condition both conditional and weighty.

topics.headline: subject delay states the event before one-or-both resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the event of reaching old age is stated before the ayah resolves whether one parent or both are in view; variant agreement shows the alternative parse without replacing the local one.
topics.reason: The standard reading is singular with delayed subject, while the dual variant is contrastive evidence for another agreement path.

topics.headline: reaching old age echoes a reversed formula in 3:40
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices old age as a relational threshold, mirrored by the reversal in (3:40).
topics.reason: The rows compare this parent-reaching-old-age construction with (3:40), where old age reaches Zachariah.

words.gloss_range: locative adverb with 2ms suffix locating aging in the addressee's presence
words.root_gloss_range: presence, nearness, possession, and being with someone; locally proximity becomes responsibility
words.prose: {{ar:عِندَكَ}} ({{tr:ʿindaka}}) locates the reaching of old age at the addressee. The parents' decline is not distant or theoretical; it happens in the addressee's presence and care-space, before the speech prohibitions begin.

topics.headline: locative suffix makes aging happen under your watch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the aging condition is located at the addressee, turning nearness into responsibility.
topics.reason: {{ar:عِندَكَ}} ({{tr:ʿindaka}}) modifies the reaching verb and carries the 2ms suffix, so the parents' aging occurs in the addressee's care-space.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative gerund naming old age as the reached state
words.root_gloss_range: bigness, greatness, magnitude, old age, and arrogance; locally advanced age is selected with a weight-of-magnitude undertone
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِبَرَ}} ({{tr:al-kibara}}) is the definite accusative state reached by the parents. The gerund names old age itself rather than labeling the parent, and the k-b-r magnitude field makes the local sense of advanced age feel weighty, though not a local activation of arrogance or unrelated greatness branches.

topics.headline: definite gerund makes old age a known destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices old age as a recognized state reached in the condition, not merely an adjective attached to a person.
topics.reason: {{ar:ٱلْكِبَرَ}} ({{tr:al-kibara}}) is the accusative object of reaching and a definite gerund naming the state.

topics.headline: magnitude field gives age moral weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local sense is advanced age, while the root's magnitude field makes that frailty feel weighty rather than trivial.
topics.reason: The local object of reaching selects old age; broader greatness and arrogance branches remain only as magnitude-pressure and same-surah contrast.

words.gloss_range: one-of-the-two expression with dual suffix inside the subject alternatives
words.root_gloss_range: oneness and singularity; locally one parent is isolated without leaving the parental pair
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدُهُمَآ}} ({{tr:aḥaduhumā}}) delays and narrows the subject to one member of the parental pair. The dual suffix keeps that one-parent scenario anchored in the two parents, and the phrase opens the scale that will include both together.

topics.headline: one parent is isolated without weakening the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a one-parent case is fully covered while still tied to the two-parent referent.
topics.reason: {{ar:أَحَدُهُمَآ}} ({{tr:aḥaduhumā}}) delays the subject and binds singular one-ness to the dual suffix.

topics.headline: one-parent case opens the scale to both parents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the care scenario scale from one parent to both without changing the obligation.
topics.reason: The sequence from {{ar:أَحَدُهُمَآ}} ({{tr:aḥaduhumā}}) to {{ar:كِلَاهُمَا}} ({{tr:kilāhumā}}) covers lighter and heavier care configurations.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive coordinator linking one-parent and both-parent alternatives
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) keeps one-parent and both-parent cases distinct while placing both under the same conditional answer. The command therefore cannot be limited to the presence of both parents.

topics.headline: or keeps one and both cases distinct under one answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command applies whether the aging case involves one parent or the full pair.
topics.reason: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) links the alternative nominative subjects inside one conditional rather than creating separate commands.

words.gloss_range: dual-totality noun with suffix naming both parents together
words.root_gloss_range: pair-totality and bothness; locally the complete parental pair is the maximum condition
words.prose: {{ar:كِلَاهُمَا}} ({{tr:kilāhumā}}) names the maximum case as both parents together. It is a marked dual-totality form, not a mere number, so the upper end of the care burden is formally weighted.

topics.headline: dual totality marks the maximum care condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names both parents together as a total pair, not just the number two.
topics.reason: {{ar:كِلَاهُمَا}} ({{tr:kilāhumā}}) is a suffix-bound dual-totality term parallel to the one-parent alternative.

words.gloss_range: apodosis connector beginning the mandated response to the condition
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from condition to response. Once aging in the addressee's presence is named, the apodosis begins immediately: no contempt sound, no harsh rebuke, and then positive noble speech.

topics.headline: fa turns condition into immediate directives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact hinge where parental aging turns into required speech discipline.
topics.reason: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the conditional answer and attaches directly to the first prohibition in the surface sequence.

topics.headline: the answer is two bans and one positive command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that care is not a single vague attitude but a graduated sequence: no contempt, no harsh repulsion, and noble speech.
topics.reason: The clause architecture after the apodosis contains two prohibitions followed by an affirmative command.

words.gloss_range: first prohibitive particle governing the jussive speech verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive speech verb governed by prohibitive lā

words.prose: The first {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive, not a neutral negator. It governs {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) as a jussive command-ban and opens the negative-negative-positive sequence by barring the smallest speech harm.

topics.headline: prohibitive lā opens the smallest speech ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response begins by forbidding the smallest harmful utterance with full command force.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive, governs jussive {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}), and starts the negative-negative-positive directive series.

words.gloss_range: 2ms jussive speech verb under prohibition
words.root_gloss_range: saying, utterance, and speech-act performance; locally even the smallest contempt sound is treated as said

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: minimal contempt utterance governed as speech content
maṣdar object naming the required speech act

words.prose: {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) makes the contempt sound an act of saying. It governs the parents as recipients and {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) as the uttered content, so even a minimal sound falls under speech ethics; its shortened jussive form also suits a command that cuts off harmful speech. The same q-w-l root then returns in {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) and {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}), turning the ayah from blocked harmful speech to required honorable speech.

topics.headline: even minimal contempt is governed as speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah treats even a contempt sound as an enacted speech act directed to the parents.
topics.reason: {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) is jussive under prohibitive {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) and governs the dative recipient plus the uttered content.

topics.headline: local q-w-l refrain turns speech from harm to honor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not anti-speech; it blocks one speech act and later commands another from the same root.
topics.reason: The rows join {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}), {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), and {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) into one speech-transformation axis.

words.gloss_range: dative lām marking parents as recipients of prohibited speech
words.prose: {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) routes the prohibited utterance to the parents. The harm is direct address, not speech about them, and the repeated dative frame later carries the positive command to the same recipients; (17:40) supplies a same-surah contrast for grave human speech about God.

topics.headline: dative lām makes the harm direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the forbidden utterance is spoken to the parents, not merely about them.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) in the dative phrase routes the prohibited speech toward the dual parental recipient.

topics.headline: same dative frame carries prohibition and command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same parents framed as recipients of both what is forbidden and what is required.
topics.reason: The dative phrase recurs before the prohibited contempt sound and before the commanded noble speech.

topics.headline: same surah contrasts parental speech with grave speech about God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah speech contrast: parental address here and grave speech about God in (17:40).
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete same-surah comparison to (17:40), where human speech about God is judged grave.

words.gloss_range: dual pronoun object of the dative lām in the prohibited-speech phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite dual parental referent picked up by the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمَآ}} ({{tr:humā}}) keeps both parents compactly present inside the first dative phrase. The pronoun avoids repeating {{ar:ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-wālidayn}}) while preserving the dual recipient at the point where contempt is forbidden.

topics.headline: dual pronoun keeps both parents inside the ban
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both parents remain present at the moment the contempt utterance is prohibited.
topics.reason: {{ar:هُمَآ}} ({{tr:humā}}) is the dual object of the dative lām and points back to {{ar:ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-wālidayn}}).

words.gloss_range: rare declined interjection functioning as the prohibited utterance
words.root_gloss_range: a small contempt or disgust sound, with lexical links to trivial irritant dirt; locally it sets the minimum threshold of disrespect
words.prose: {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) is a tiny contempt interjection made grammatically countable as the thing not to be said. Its lexical tie to a trivial irritant and its pressed sound set the floor of disrespect extremely low; variant case endings shift classification around a stable contempt core. The same rare word is legitimate against idols in (21:67), prohibited toward parents here, and appears in parental contempt in (46:17).

topics.headline: tiny contempt sound becomes a prohibited object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the floor of disrespect is set extremely low: even a tiny irritated sound counts.
topics.reason: {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) is governed by {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) and has lexical pressure from a trivial irritant, making minimal contempt legally visible.

topics.headline: case variants vary around a stable contempt sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant case treatment affects classification, while the contempt sound itself remains stable.
topics.reason: The qirāʾāt rows vary endings and tanwīn but do not replace the local interjection core.

topics.headline: rare word reverses legitimate and forbidden contempt contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same rare contempt word can be legitimate against idols in (21:67) but forbidden toward parents here and appears again in parental contempt at (46:17).
topics.reason: The rows provide the concrete occurrences (21:67), (17:23), and (46:17), allowing target-boundary contrast.

topics.headline: geminated sound makes impatience audible

words.prose: {{ar:تَنْهَرْهُمَا}} ({{tr:tanharhumā}}) is a jussive transitive verb with the parents built in as direct dual objects. Local grammar selects harsh rebuke or repulsion, while the broader n-h-r river/day range is only a narrowed force-image: the rebuke must not overwhelm vulnerable parents, and the rare verbal deployment makes that interpersonal force stand out among mostly noun uses. The same ban protects a vulnerable petitioner in (93:10), and the harsher sound texture contrasts with the later noble-speech ending.

topics.headline: dual suffix makes parents direct affected objects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibited harshness lands directly on both parents, built into the verb by the dual suffix.
topics.reason: {{ar:تَنْهَرْهُمَا}} ({{tr:tanharhumā}}) is jussive under prohibition and carries the dual object suffix directly, without a preposition.

topics.headline: local grammar selects rebuke while preserving force imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local sense is harsh rebuke, while the river/day root range adds an overpowering-force undertone rather than a literal water image.
topics.reason: The transitive jussive verbal context blocks river or day as local senses, but the root evidence keeps force imagery available as a qualified pressure.

topics.reason: The rows cite the same prohibitive structure in (93:10), with a petitioner there and aging parents here.

topics.headline: sound texture suits forceful repulsion

topics.reason: The phonetic row links the n-h-r cluster to harsh repulsion and contrasts it with the closing speech phrase.

words.gloss_range: connector pivoting from the paired prohibitions to the positive command
words.prose: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from what must not be done to what must be said. It coordinates the positive imperative with the two bans and carries a corrective force: not contempt, not rebuke, but noble speech.

topics.headline: final wāw pivots from bans to commanded speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at restraint; the connector turns avoidance of harm into a positive speech duty.
topics.reason: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) to the prior prohibitions and carries a corrective turn from “do not” to “say.”

words.gloss_range: 2ms imperative speech verb requiring an affirmative address
words.root_gloss_range: saying and utterance; locally the same speech root turns from blocked contempt to commanded noble speech

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier prohibited speech verb echoed by the imperative

words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) is the affirmative imperative that resolves the speech sequence. After the jussive prohibitions, it requires enacted verbal address to the parents, completed by the same recipient frame and by {{ar:قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan karīman}}) as the quality-governed speech act. The local echo from {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) to {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) shows that the goal is transformed speech, not silence, while the particle-driven warning logic from (17:22) becomes condition-response obligation here.

topics.headline: imperative requires enacted noble address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the required response is not silence but an affirmative act of speech to the parents.
topics.reason: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) is a direct imperative completed by a dative recipient and {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) as its speech object.

topics.headline: negative saying becomes commanded saying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the climax of the sequence: blocked contempt is resolved by speech transformed into honor.
topics.reason: The local echo from {{ar:تَقُل}} ({{tr:taqul}}) to {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) reverses polarity inside the same speech root.

topics.headline: particle architecture maps condition to response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuity with the prior ayah's pivot logic: particles move from warning to response obligation.
topics.reason: The boundary row compares the particle pivot from (17:22) with the condition-response architecture in (17:23).

words.gloss_range: second dative lām routing noble speech to the same parents
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) sends the commanded speech to the same parents protected by the prohibitions. The repeated dative form binds restraint and honor to one recipient pair.

topics.headline: second dative routes noble speech to the protected pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same dual recipient protected from contempt now receives commanded honor.
topics.reason: The second {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) repeats the dative route to the parents before {{ar:قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan karīman}}).

words.gloss_range: final dual pronoun preserving both parents as noble-speech recipients
words.prose: {{ar:هُمَا}} ({{tr:humā}}) again preserves the dual parental recipient. Even in the positive command, the grammar does not let one parent fade from view.

topics.headline: final pronoun sustains both parents through the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that neither parent recedes when the ayah turns to positive noble speech.
topics.reason: {{ar:هُمَا}} ({{tr:humā}}) again points to the two parents as the genitive object of the dative lām.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative maṣdar as cognate object of the command to say
words.root_gloss_range: meaningful utterance and speech; locally the speech act itself becomes the regulated object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperative that governs the cognate speech object
qualitative adjective constraining the speech noun

words.prose: {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) makes the speech act itself the object of command. As a cognate maṣdar after {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}), it foregrounds the produced utterance; as an indefinite noun, it does not prescribe one script but leaves content open under the constraint of {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}). Surah 17 then shows a wider qualified-speech taxonomy in (17:28) and (17:40).

topics.headline: cognate maṣdar foregrounds the utterance itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command regulates the produced utterance itself, not just the speaker's inner attitude.
topics.reason: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) plus {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) repeats the speech root as verb and maṣdar, while agreement binds the following adjective to the noun.

topics.headline: indefinite speech allows many utterances under noble quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not script one formula; it opens the content while constraining its quality.
topics.reason: {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) is indefinite, so the utterance remains open as long as {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) truly qualifies it.

topics.headline: Surah 17 catalogs qualified speech forms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that noble parental speech in (17:23) belongs to a same-surah taxonomy of speech qualities, including gentle speech in (17:28) and grave speech in (17:40).
topics.reason: The rows cite (17:23), (17:28), and (17:40), with shared qawl framing and context-specific adjectives.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative adjective qualifying the commanded speech
words.root_gloss_range: nobility, generosity, honor, preciousness, and dignity; locally these qualities must characterize the utterance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier forbidden contempt sound answered by noble speech

words.prose: {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) locks noble quality onto the commanded speech through agreement with {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}). Its generosity, honor, and dignity range means the utterance must actively confer respect, not merely avoid insult. The exact noble-speech formula is distinctive for parental address, while k-r-m echoes human honoring in (17:70) and Satan's reference to the honored one in (17:62); the closing tanwīn cadence also answers the earlier {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}) with a nobler sound pattern.

topics.headline: agreement makes nobility inseparable from the utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nobility is grammatically required of the speech itself, not left as a vague attitude around it.
topics.reason: {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) matches {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}) in accusative indefiniteness and functions as its qualitative adjective.

topics.headline: karīm makes speech give dignity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demanded words must confer honor and dignity, not merely avoid insult.
topics.reason: The k-r-m lexical evidence includes nobility, generosity, honor, preciousness, and forgiving when able to punish; locally those qualities modify speech.

topics.headline: parental address receives a marked formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing phrase as a distinctive parental-address formula, connected to the ayah's earlier excellence and to honoring language in (17:70) and (17:62).
topics.reason: The rows mark the exact phrase as unique here, compare related formulas such as (17:28) and (4:63), and link k-r-m to (17:70) and (17:62).

topics.headline: tanwīn cadence links forbidden and required speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing noble-speech phrase answer the earlier contempt sound while the boundary turns forsakenness into the duty to grant honor.
topics.reason: The sound row links {{ar:أُفٍّۢ}} ({{tr:uffin}}), {{ar:قَوْلًۭا}} ({{tr:qawlan}}), and {{ar:كَرِيمًۭا}} ({{tr:karīman}}) by cadence, and the boundary row contrasts withheld support with generous speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قضى ربك ألا تعبدوا إلا إياه وبالوالدين إحسانا
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive lordly settlement joins exclusive worship to active beneficence toward both parents. The second clause is not an optional courtesy appended to theology; it is placed inside the same binding order, and ihsan demands positive good rather than bare non-injury.

activation_trace.role: The cutting judgment branch makes the opening a settled and binding frame for both clauses.
Lordship and mastery supply the authority under which worship and parental conduct are joined.
Humble obedient worship defines the exclusive vertical allegiance that immediately governs the human relation.
The two parents specifically identified through birth make embodied origin, not generic seniority, the relation at issue.
Beneficent and well-executed action, including surplus beyond strict justice, turns the clause into an affirmative practice.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a religious command followed by a family command.
changed_reading.after: The family command belongs to the same decisive settlement as exclusive worship, so theology is immediately tested as active excellence toward one's parents.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إما يبلغن عندك الكبر أحدهما أو كلاهما
baseline_models.mechanism: The duty intensifies when old age reaches its endpoint within the addressee's own sphere. Nearness removes abstraction, the weight of age increases vulnerability, and the one-or-both construction prevents either scale of need from escaping the command.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a temporal endpoint makes aging a reached condition that triggers the detailed speech duties.
Nearness and presence locate parental vulnerability inside the addressee's immediate field of responsibility.
Senescence and long duration identify the life-stage whose arrival changes the relation.
The branch of burdensome weight exposes why this stage can strain the caregiver and why restraint is specified.
Singularity keeps the duty fully active even when only one parent reaches the condition.
Dual encompassment closes the other case by including both parents without dilution of responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives an age-contingent rule for speaking politely.
changed_reading.after: Old age arriving within one's own household or reach creates a non-evadable proximity duty, whether dependency appears in one parent or both.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فلا تقل لهما أف ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence intercepts an escalation: a minimal sound of disgust, then forceful verbal expulsion, then an explicit replacement utterance. Silence is insufficient; the mouth must be retrained from reactive discharge into speech that actively confers honor.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance appears in prohibition, command, and object form, making voiced speech the controlled medium.
The smallest voiced discharge of weariness marks the earliest detectable point in the escalation.
Harsh verbal driving-away supplies the stronger aggressive endpoint that must also be blocked.
Honor, generosity, and pardon qualify the replacement speech as dignity-giving rather than merely neutral.

changed_reading.after: Interrupt the whole verbal escalation from reflexive sigh to forceful rebuke, then actively replace it with speech that restores and displays their honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns the focus into a developmental reversal. Those who raised the addressee through smallness now reach old age nearby; the presently stronger body lowers its side without humiliation, encloses them in mercy, and converts remembered nurture into present care and prayer.

activation_trace.role: Birth-origin identifies the pair whose earlier generative role is about to be reversed.
Old age supplies the later-life endpoint at which the direction of practical care changes.
Lowering after height turns the adult child's present strength into a deliberate downward movement toward the parents.
Wing as side, hand, and shelter gives the lowering an embodied protective shape.
Gentleness of side without abasement distinguishes chosen tenderness from degrading submission.
Tender mercy supplies both the motive for bodily lowering and the substance requested in prayer.
Feeding and gradual growth name the parents' earlier work that the adult child's care now answers.
Smallness opposite old age completes the life-course reversal between dependency at the two ends.

structural_cues: The old-age condition in 17:23 is immediately answered by the memory of being raised while small in 17:24.
The imperatives move from governing the mouth to lowering the body and then to prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies old age, smallness, nurture, lowered embodiment, and mercy; I supply the arrow from remembered upward nurture to transformed downward care. A live alternative is simple gratitude rather than a full role-reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The aged parent receives deference because of status and kinship.
changed_reading.after: The adult child reenacts care in reverse across the life course: remembered nurture is translated into gentle embodied protection when the former caregivers become vulnerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The absolute speech boundary is followed by inward knowledge, sound orientation, repeated return, and covering forgiveness. This preserves the prohibition while placing filial conduct inside a repairable discipline: inner resentment matters, outward polish alone is insufficient, and a lapse need not become permanent estrangement.

activation_trace.role: The involuntary-seeming sound of weariness exposes the boundary between inner pressure and voiced harm.
Overt speech remains the observable practice that must be changed rather than excused.
Disclosure to the knower moves evaluation behind the polished utterance into the agent's actual orientation.
The inward seat of thought and alarm supplies the hidden field known beneath speech.
Soundness opposed to corruption makes the relevant inner direction constructive rather than merely emotional.
Returning to a place of return makes correction repeatable after departure from the commanded manner.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer from its residue keeps repair from becoming denial of the wrong.

structural_cues: 17:25 immediately follows the detailed parental speech commands.
The conditional sound orientation is paired with a plural description of habitual returners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward knowledge, soundness, return, and forgiveness; I supply the arrow from those cues to repair after failures in filial speech. The live alternative is that 17:25 offers general reassurance without specifically modeling such lapses.

changed_reading.before: The command is chiefly an external threshold governing which words may be uttered.
changed_reading.after: The threshold belongs to an inward and repeatable repair practice: intention is exposed, return remains possible, and forgiveness supports correction without weakening the ban on harmful speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding commands turn ihsan into a calibrated care economy. A relative's claim is a due right; when material giving is unavailable, accessible speech still preserves relation; generosity must avoid both a shackled hand and total extension; and capacity is measured rather than imagined as limitless.

activation_trace.role: Active beneficence supplies the focus practice whose material scope and limits are clarified by the sequence.
A binding entitlement changes kin-directed goodness from discretionary generosity into something owed.
Voiced speech remains an available act when the giver must turn away from a material request.
Ease after difficulty makes speech a low-friction form of care that keeps scarcity from becoming relational harshness.
The binding collar supplies the image of disabling restraint at one failed extreme of giving.
An entirely released hand supplies the opposite extreme of unbounded expenditure.
Restriction to a small measure introduces real capacity limits into the practice of provision.
The balance of justice supplies a governing metric between withholding and self-defeating excess.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from giving a relative's right, through graceful speech under inability, to the two extremes of the hand and finally to just measure.
Speech recurs as an act precisely where material transfer cannot occur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies right, substitute speech, opposed hand positions, restricted provision, and balance; I supply the arrow back to parental ihsan as a sustainable allocation practice. A live alternative is that these are adjacent duties to other recipients rather than specifications of parental care.

changed_reading.before: Ihsan to parents means open-ended generosity and kind words.
changed_reading.after: Ihsan is an owed but calibrated practice: give within real capacity, never convert inability into contempt, and let dignifying speech continue care when material provision cannot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The birth-root changes roles from parents in the focus to children in 17:31. At one end of life, aged parents may strain the adult child; at the other, children may appear economically threatening. The paired sequence blocks a shared failure: treating a dependent generation as disposable when care becomes costly.

activation_trace.role: Parents viewed from the event of birth establish the older generation as one pole of the relation.
The burdensome weight of old age makes the potential pressure on the adult caregiver explicit.
Children as offspring reverse the birth-root's participant direction and expose the younger dependent generation.
Taking life supplies the extreme form of eliminating a dependent to escape perceived cost.
Fear with dread identifies the affective pressure that can turn provision anxiety into violence.
A hand stripped of wealth supplies the economic rationale under which the dependent is falsely recast as expendable.
Allocated provision counters the premise that survival must be secured by removing the other generation.

structural_cues: The same birth-root names parents in 17:23 and children in 17:31.
Both passages address pressure created by a dependent family member, but from opposite generational directions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root reversal, age-burden, poverty fear, killing, and provision; I supply the common anti-disposability rule across the two generations. A live alternative is to keep infanticide wholly separate from care of aged parents.

changed_reading.before: The focus imposes a one-way upward duty from adult child to aging parent.
changed_reading.after: It becomes one pole of a bidirectional intergenerational protection: neither generation may answer the other generation's dependency by erasure, contempt, or abandonment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated reaching verb marks opposite thresholds. In the focus, a parent reaches old age inside the child's care; in 17:34, an orphan reaches mature strength inside a guardian's custody. Fulfilment and a repeatedly maintained covenant recast power over a vulnerable person's affairs as temporary stewardship rather than ownership.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the endpoint introduces old age as one threshold at which another person's duty becomes active.
Senescence defines the late-life threshold and its altered practical dependency.
A child cut off from a caretaker supplies the contrasting vulnerable person placed under another's power.
The same reaching-to-an-endpoint branch links the two passages while the destination changes from old age to maturity.
Arrival at mature strength supplies the early-life threshold opposite parental senescence.
Completion without deficit makes stewardship answerable for returning every due intact.
Preserving something through repeated attention supplies the temporal discipline of trustworthy custody.

structural_cues: The exact root ب ل غ governs both reaching old age in 17:23 and reaching mature strength in 17:34.
The two complements point to opposite ends of a life course while each passage regulates power around vulnerability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reaching, opposite age thresholds, orphan custody, completion, and maintained covenant; I supply the analogy that parental care is likewise custodial rather than possessive. A live alternative is that the repetition only coordinates distinct legal thresholds.

changed_reading.before: The child owes kindness once a parent becomes old.
changed_reading.after: The child holds a stewardship at a late-life threshold, parallel to guardianship at the threshold before maturity: vulnerability grants responsibility, not ownership or unchecked control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ban on following what one does not know, followed by the accountability of hearing, sight, and heart, adds an epistemic brake to the focus speech sequence. Noble speech toward aging parents is not only gentle in tone; it refuses to turn partial perception, repeated frustration, or fault-tracking into confident accusation.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance is the point where an untested judgment can become relational harm.
Harsh rebuke is the speech act whose apparent certainty and force require restraint.
Following an apparent trace supplies the mechanism by which incomplete evidence can harden into a claim.
Actual disclosure to the knower sets the evidentiary threshold that reactive interpretation may fail.
Hearing as understanding and response turns listening into accountable reception rather than ammunition.
Insight of the heart distinguishes surface observation from the deeper seeing needed before judgment.
The heart as an inward heat-center exposes the affective furnace from which rebuke can issue.
Questioning and demand make every sensory and inward input answerable for the speech built from it.

structural_cues: A command about utterance in 17:23 is later paired with a prohibition on pursuing the unknown.
Hearing, sight, and heart are individually named and then gathered under accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech control, non-pursuit without knowledge, accountable senses, and the heated heart; I supply the arrow from epistemic restraint to family speech under frustration. A live alternative is a general rule for testimony and belief with no special return to parents.

changed_reading.before: Noble speech is primarily a matter of respectful wording and tone.
changed_reading.after: Noble speech also requires epistemic discipline: listen, test what is known, and do not convert frustration or partial perception into a forceful verdict on aging parents.

context_deltas.mechanism: A deictic and theological frame closes around the focus. The parents reach old age 'at you,' while the sequence's evils are judged 'at your Lord.' The opening lordly settlement and exclusive worship return as revealed wisdom and the rejection of another deity. The domestic site is therefore a delegated field under divine evaluation, not the adult child's private sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment opens the unit as an authoritative settlement rather than private advice.
Lordship locates ultimate mastery above the adult child who may hold practical household power.
Near presence marks the child's immediate household sphere as the site where conduct occurs.
The repeated nearness construction relocates final assessment from what is at the child to what stands before the Lord.
Repeated lordship makes the household actor accountable to a higher owner and governor.
Divine non-acceptance supplies the evaluative polarity against the noble speech commanded in the focus.
Divinely given instruction identifies the intervening social commands as revealed guidance.
Accurate wisdom supplies the coherent governing intelligence of the whole command sequence.
Worship and the worshiped one restore the opening exclusivity and close the social ethic inside theology.

structural_cues: The construction عندك in 17:23 returns as عند ربك in 17:38.
The unit opens with a lordly settlement and exclusive worship, then closes by naming revealed wisdom and forbidding another deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the deictic echo and theological bookend; I supply the arrow that makes the household a delegated jurisdiction under divine review. A live alternative is that the echoes close the whole command list without specifically intensifying parental care.

changed_reading.before: The adult child governs conduct within a private family relationship.
changed_reading.after: The parent's presence 'at you' is simultaneously conduct 'before your Lord': domestic power is delegated, bounded, and answerable to the lordship worshiped at the ayah's opening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كلاهما functions here as dual totality, while the sheltered-harbor branch is form-distant and must not replace that grammar. It remains anchored in the packet's ك ل و inventory, the focus's عندك, and the following lowered wing; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary spatial analogy.

activation_trace.role: Near presence gives the exploratory shelter image an actual domestic location.
Encompassing both preserves the construction's primary dual force before any secondary image is activated.
A harbor screened from wind supplies the contained image of receiving both vulnerable parents into protection.
Wing as shelter gives the imagined harbor a protective bodily canopy.
Lowering wing and voice turns shelter into a posture enacted through body and sound.

changed_reading.before: Whether one parent or both are present, the same rule applies.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial image, both parents arriving 'at you' can be received like vulnerable lives in a sheltered harbor, with lowered body and voice forming cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because تنهرهما plainly activates rebuke in context, while river-cutting and opening-to-flow are remote branches of the same root. The reading remains anchored in the focus's rebuke-to-noble-speech sequence and the later expansion, restriction, and balance imagery; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, never as the lexical sense of the verb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما

activation_trace.role: Harsh verbal rebuke preserves the verb's primary contribution and supplies the force being regulated.
A river cutting earth with abundant flow supplies the exploratory image of speech force carving into vulnerability.
Opening and widening until flow is released models how an unchecked inner pressure becomes a verbal torrent.
Audible speech is the channel whose discharge is redirected from rebuke to a commanded replacement.
Good rain and fertile growth supply the counter-image of speech that nourishes rather than erodes.
Spreading and extension provide the first contextual control variable for released force.
Constriction to a limited measure provides the opposed control variable.
A just balance contains the flow analogy by requiring measured force rather than mere release.

changed_reading.before: Do not rebuke the parents; speak nobly.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material image, do not let accumulated pressure become a scouring verbal channel through their vulnerability; measure its force so speech nourishes rather than erodes.

strongest_changes: 17:24 changes deference into a life-course reversal in which remembered nurture becomes gentle embodied care.
17:26-35 changes ihsan from unbounded sentiment into an owed, sustainable, and measured care economy.
The birth-root reversal in 17:31 places aged parents and vulnerable children inside one intergenerational anti-disposability mechanism.
The echo from عندك to عند ربك places household power under divine lordship and review.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were structural rather than topical: opposite life thresholds linked by ب ل غ, generational role reversal through و ل د, speech retained as care when material giving fails, and the deictic transfer from the child's near-space to the Lord's evaluative presence.
remaining_uncertainties: The calibrated-care model may be a deliberate return to parental ihsan, or the sequence may chiefly coordinate distinct duties to distinct recipients.
The inward repair cues of 17:25 may specifically qualify filial lapses or may offer only general moral reassurance.
The harbor and hydraulic readings are intentionally contained branch activations; neither should displace the immediate grammar or primary lexical senses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exclusive worship is tested as speech restraint at another's decline.** `ق ض ي:B001` gives decisive command, `ع ب د:B003` submissive obedience, `ء ف ف:B001` disgust, `ن ه ر:B004` harsh rebuke, and `ك ر م:B001/B010` generous nobility and valuedness. The command descends from divine exclusivity into the micro-choices of speech toward aged parents. I infer worship's vertical claim must produce horizontal preservation of vulnerable worth. “Noble speech” becomes enacted servanthood.
2. **Old age reverses the direction of nurture.** `و ل د:B002/B003` encodes birth relation, `ب ل غ:B001` reaching a limit, and `ك ب ر:B004` agedness. Later 17:24 explicitly recalls being raised small. I infer the child now becomes the proximal holder of those who once carried growth. The ayah reads aging as a relational handover rather than private decline.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:62–65 contrasts Satan's attempt to bridle descendants with the protected solidity of servants. Gentle care for dependent parents becomes a local counter-practice to domination.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Noble speech as support at the threshold of dependence.** Lexical evidence: `ن ه ر B004` (harsh verbal rebuke) in negated `تَنْهَرْهُمَا`, and `ك ر م B001` (praiseworthy nobility and generosity) in `كَرِيمًا`. Structural cue: the parents reach old age `عِندَكَ`; 17:22 warns against being left unsupported, 17:24 supplies the sheltering wing, and 17:26 extends due claims to kin. Assigned role: rebuke would push the dependent away, whereas noble speech receives and sustains them socially. Abductive move: the packet supplies proximity, age, and contrasting speech commands; I infer that verbal hospitality is part of material care. Reading change: `قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا` is not decorative politeness but a generous support practice precisely when parental strength has receded.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:24's sheltering wing and 17:28's easy word confirmed that noble speech is part of a support system; it keeps vulnerable persons socially received even when material help is delayed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Care received in weakness returns when age reverses dependency, moving from controlled speech to lowered posture and inward return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Filial mercy takes avian form as a lowered wing, harsh speech is a forceful verbal outburst, and repentance is a homeward bodily recurrence covered against injury.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Speech at the Threshold of Old Age
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: When parents reach advanced age in the child's presence, disgust and forceful rebuke are withheld and replaced by speech that confers honor.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: parents through birth (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); reaching an endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); old age (`quranic:root_001281:B004/m01`); sound of disgust (`quranic:root_000039:B001/m01`); forceful verbal rebuke (`quranic:root_001559:B004/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); honorable generosity (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Aging creates a threshold at which power has reversed. The smallest expulsion of disgust and the larger force of rebuke are both blocked; speech instead becomes an act of conferring worth. Care is thus first regulated at the mouth.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir gereksinimi, ibadeti, süreyi veya başka bir işi tamamlayıp bitirme ile bir şeyin geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve yok olması aşamalarını açıkça destekler. concept_map.definition: Bir işi, gereksinimi, ibadeti veya süreyi son sınırına ulaştırıp tamamlamak; ya da bir şeyin süresi dolarak geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve ortadan kalkmasıdır.

source_note.AY: Uzun süre aynı yerde bırakılan tulumun bu yüzden bozulup eskimesi dalın tek tanıklığıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, kuru üzüm çekirdeğini adlandıran bir ad biçimi ile bu çekirdeği yeme eylemini aynı tanıklıkta açıkça verir. Geçici çerçeve, yiyecek nesnesi ile onu yeme eylemi arasındaki ayrımı koruyarak kaynağı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kuru üzüm çekirdeğinin adı ve onu yeme kalıbıdır; genel yemek yeme veya başka meyve parçalarını adlandırma anlamına genişlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, kuru üzüm çekirdeğini adlandıran biçim ile bu çekirdeği yeme söz öbeğini ayrı tutar; özel yiyecek nesnesi genel yeme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Kuru üzüm çekirdeğini adlandırmak ve belirli söz öbeğinde kişinin bu çekirdeği yemesini anlatmaktır.

facets.statement: Kuru üzümün içindeki çekirdeği belirli bir adla belirtme.
Belirli söz öbeğinde kişinin kuru üzüm çekirdeğini yemesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için kaynaklar arası ortak bir özet kurulamaz; yiyecek nesnesi ve onu yeme eylemi tek bir sözlük kaydında birlikte tanıklanır.

source_details.summary: Kuru üzüm çekirdeğinin adı ve kişinin bu çekirdeği yemesi dalın tek tanıklığında birlikte verilir.

concept_gloss.text: kuru üzüm çekirdeği ve onu yemek
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yiyecek nesnesini ve yalnızca belirli söz öbeğinde tanıklanan yeme eylemini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kuru üzüm çekirdeği nesnesini ve bu çekirdeği yeme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözcük bir yiyecek nesnesinin, yani kuru üzümün çekirdeğinin adı olarak kullanıldığında geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Adlandırılan yiyecek nesnesini tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu çekirdeği yeme eylemini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin bu belirli yiyecek parçasını yediğini bildiren söz öbeğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yiyecek nesnesini ve onu yeme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Çekirdeğin bağımsız ad olarak kullanılmasını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kuru üzüm çekirdeğini yeme eylemini belirli bir söz öbeğinde adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çekirdekle ilgili satıcı adını ve başka türemiş adları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kuru üzümün çekirdeğini yiyecek nesnesi olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Nesne adında iki dal örtüşür; odak dal ayrıca bu çekirdeği yeme kalıbını içerirken komşu dal çekirdekten türeyen başka adlara uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yenilen şeyi kuru üzüm çekirdeğiyle sınırlar ve aynı zamanda bu nesnenin adını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her türlü yiyeceği yeme, yedirme, lokma ve yeme sıklığı gibi genel kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin bir yiyeceği ağzına alıp yemesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel yeme alanıdır; odak dal yalnızca kuru üzüm çekirdeği nesnesi ve onu yeme söz öbeğiyle sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı yiyecek nesnesini adlandıran dal ile genel yeme dalı en yararlı karşılaştırmaları verdi, başka meyve ve bitki adları yalnızca aynı alanda kaldığı için yayımlanmadı.

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir işi kesin karara bağlama çekirdeğinden kesin bildirim, ölümle sonlanma, tamamlanıp tükenme, kusursuzca yapıp yürürlüğe koyma ve borç ilişkisini kapatma dallarına yayılır. Bunun yanında uzun süre bırakılan tulumun bozulması ile kuru üzüm çekirdeği ve onu yeme anlamları ayrı sözlüksel dallar oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi, yönetim ve düzenleme çekirdeğini destekler. Bununla birlikte yalın ve mutlak kullanım Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insanlar ve nesneler için anlam, sahip olunan ya da yönetilen şeyin belirtilmesine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ile bir şeyin sahibi ya da yöneticisi olmayı bildiren tamlamalı kullanım ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim ile ev, hayvan veya başka bir şey üzerinden kurulan tamlamalar aynı kapsamda değildir; tanım bu kullanım koşulunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık ya da şey üzerinde sahiplik, üstün yetke ve düzenleyici yönetim kurma niteliğidir. Mutlak kullanım Tanrı'yı gösterirken başka kullanımlar yönetilen veya sahip olunan şeyi açıkça belirtir.

facets.statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
Mutlak adlandırma Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insan için kullanım belirtilmiş bir şeye bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sahip, buyruğu geçen yönetici, düzenleyici ve Tanrı anlamlarını ortak bir üstün yetke ilişkisi çevresinde toplar; mutlak kullanımın sınırını ayrıca belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sahiplik ile düzenleyici yetkenin birlikte anlatıldığı genel kavramsal bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sahiplik, üstün yetke ve yönetim çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın hiçbir bağlı unsur olmadan mutlak kullanıldığı inanç bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Mutlak kullanımın yalnız Tanrı'yı göstermesi sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ev, hayvan veya başka bir varlık üzerinde sahiplik ve yönetim bildiren tamlamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen şey üzerindeki sahiplik ve yönetim ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı; sahip, buyruğu geçen yönetici veya düzenleyici
evin sahibi veya ev işlerini yöneten kadın

error_profile.preserves: Üstün konum ve buyruk yetkisi yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Sahiplik, düzenleme ve Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ayrımını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mutlak kullanımın yalnız Tanrı'ya ayrılması ve düzenleyici yönetim boyutu bu daldadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tapınılan nesne ve yükselme çağrışımı komşu dalın ek alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin sahibi, yöneticisi veya üstün konumdaki varlığı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme sahiplik ve üstünlük alanındadır; odak dal kullanımın mutlak ya da tamlamalı oluşunu ve düzenleyici yönetimi sınırlar, komşu dal ise tapınma nesnesine ve yükselme çağrışımına da açılır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sahiplik ve üstün yetke bakımından en yakın sınır karşılaştırmasını veren dal seçildi, yalnız aynı genel alanı paylaşan adaylar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرب بمعنى الله تعالى، ومالك الشيء، وسيده المطاع، وصاحبه، ورب الدار والدابة والملك
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس حرف رب، ولا الرُّبّ الطلاء، ولا الربابة الوعاء أو العهد
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir çocuğun veya canlı varlığın gelişimini üstlenme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeltme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu korur.
Gözetim ve ilgilenme yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Düzeltme, aşamalı geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözetilen şeyi aşama aşama geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucu odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aralıklı yoklama, öğüt verme ve çevresel bakım gibi tamamlanma gerektirmeyen kullanımlar komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bakımını üstlenme, onu düzeltme ve iyi durumda tutma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelişim sürecini tamamlanma sınırına taşır; komşu dal ise bakımın yinelenmesini ve gözetimi sonuçtan bağımsız olarak kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım ile tamamlama arasındaki en ince sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız büyüme, akrabalık veya olgunluk alanını paylaşanlar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست السيادة المجردة بلا معنى الإصلاح، ولا القرابة الربيبة نفسها
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب الرجل النعمة يربها ربا؛ ربابة أيضا إذا تممها (jamhara); رب الضيعة أي أصلحها وأتمها؛ رب فلان ولده؛ رباه (sihah); رب الشيء أي أصلحه؛ رب فلان الصنيعة إذا أتمها وأصلحها (tahdhib); التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام؛ ربه ورباه ورببه (mufradat); رب فلان ضيعته إذا قام على إصلاحها؛ رببت الصبي أربه (maqayis); ربته تربيتا إذا رببه (maqayis-rbt)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sıradan bilgi sahipliğini değil, Tanrı bilgisi, dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bilgin ve öğretici kişi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka yapılardan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı bilgisine ve dinî hükümlere hâkim, bilgece davranan ve insanları temel bilgiden ileri bilgiye doğru yetiştiren bilgindir.

facets.statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
Bilgiyi yalnız taşımakla kalmaz, başkalarını küçük adımlarla öğretip yetiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar Tanrı'yı bilme, dinî hükümleri kavrama, bilgelik ve aşamalı öğreticilik özelliklerini aynı bilgin kişide bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinî bilgi, bilgelik ve öğretici yetiştiricilik özelliklerinin birlikte vurgulandığı kişi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı bilgisi, bilginlik ve aşamalı öğreticilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin dinî uzmanlığı ile insan yetiştirme görevini birlikte anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı bilgisi ve insanları temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştirme görevi odak dalda belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dinî hukuk hükümlerinde uzmanlaşma komşu dalın daha dar mesleki sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dinî hükümleri bilen ve bu alanda yetkin sayılan bilgini gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dinî bilgiyi Tanrı bilgisi, bilgelik ve öğreticilikle genişletir; komşu dal ise özellikle dinî hukuk bilgisinde uzmanlaşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dinî uzmanlık ile öğretici bilgin kimliği arasındaki sınırı en açık gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız bilgelik veya saygınlık bildiren adaylar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الربيون إذا أريد بهم الألوف والجماعات، ولا ربان الملاحين
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرباني: المتأله العارف بالله تعالى (sihah); الرباني: العالم؛ العلماء بالحلال والحرام؛ حكماء علماء؛ العالم المعلم الذي يغذو الناس بصغار العلوم (tahdhib); الرباني... يرب العلم؛ يرب نفسه بالعلم؛ منسوب إلى الرب (mufradat); الربي العارف بالرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çok sayıdaki insanın bir topluluk oluşturması ve ayrı kabilelerin tek bir birlik hâlinde toplanması çekirdeğini destekler. Sayı değeri ve belirli kabile birliği bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan topluluğu anlamı, yalnız herhangi bir çoğulluğu değil büyük sayı veya fiilî birleşme niteliğini taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan büyük insan topluluğu ve birleşmiş kabileler alanında kalır; hayvan sürüsü anlamı bu dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Çok sayıda insanın bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan büyük topluluk ya da ayrı kabilelerin ortak bir birlik hâlinde birleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, insanların büyük sayıda bir araya gelerek topluluk oluşturmasıdır.
On bin kişilik topluluk ve beş kabilenin tek birlik olması tanıklanan özel örneklerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar binlerce kişilik toplulukları, on bin kişilik bir sayıyı ve birleşmiş kabileleri büyük sayı ile toplanma ortaklığında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çok sayıda insanın ya da birleşmiş kabilelerin oluşturduğu topluluğu genel olarak anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanlardan oluşma, büyüklük ve bir araya gelme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayrı kabilelerin tek bir ortak birlik oluşturduğu tarihsel topluluk bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kabilelerin toplanıp tek birlik oluşturması yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karışık unsurlar, ordu ve genel toplama sonucu oluşan birlikler komşu dalda daha geniş yer tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanların bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan topluluğu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal büyük sayı ile kabile birliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise sayı veya kabile koşulu olmadan her türlü toplanmış grubu kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel topluluk ile büyük ve birleşmiş topluluk arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösteren aday seçildi, öteki yakın grup adları tekrara düşmemek için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
